package main

func main() {
	a := make([]int, 3, 5)
	b := a[:2]
	b[0] = 9
	println(a[0], len(b), cap(b))
	c := append(b, 7)
	println(a[2], c[2], len(c), cap(c))
	d := a[1:2:3]
	println(len(d), cap(d))
	e := []int{1, 2, 3, 4}
	n := copy(e[1:], e[:3])
	println(n, e[0], e[1], e[2], e[3])
	var nilslice []int
	println(len(nilslice), cap(nilslice), nilslice == nil)
	nilslice = append(nilslice, 1)
	println(len(nilslice), nilslice == nil)
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(strconv.Itoa(-42), strconv.FormatInt(255, 16), strconv.FormatInt(-7, 2))
	n, err := strconv.Atoi("123")
	fmt.Println(n, err == nil)
	_, err = strconv.Atoi("12x")
	fmt.Println(err != nil)
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt("-7f", 16, 64)
	fmt.Println(v, err == nil)
	fmt.Println(strconv.FormatFloat(1.5, 'f', 3, 64), strconv.FormatFloat(1234.5678, 'e', 2, 64))
	fmt.Println(strconv.FormatFloat(0.000001234, 'g', -1, 64))
	f, err := strconv.ParseFloat("2.5e3", 64)
	fmt.Println(f, err == nil)
	fmt.Println(strconv.Quote("a\tb\"c"), strconv.FormatBool(true))
	b, _ := strconv.ParseBool("TRUE")
	fmt.Println(b)
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	s := "Hello, World"
	fmt.Println(strings.ToUpper(s), strings.ToLower(s))
	fmt.Println(strings.Contains(s, "World"), strings.HasPrefix(s, "He"), strings.HasSuffix(s, "ld"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Index(s, "o"), strings.LastIndex(s, "o"), strings.Index(s, "zz"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Split("a,b,,c", ","), len(strings.Split("", ",")))
	fmt.Println(strings.Join([]string{"x", "y", "z"}, "-"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Replace("aaaa", "a", "b", 2), strings.Replace("aaaa", "a", "b", -1))
	fmt.Println("["+strings.TrimSpace("  pad \t\n")+"]", strings.Repeat("ab", 3))
	fmt.Println(strings.Fields("  a  b\tc\n"), strings.Count("cheese", "e"))
	fmt.Println(strings.TrimLeft("xxhixx", "x"), strings.TrimRight("xxhixx", "x"), strings.Trim("xxhixx", "x"))
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	d := 90 * time.Second
	fmt.Println(d, d.Seconds(), d.Nanoseconds())
	fmt.Println(time.Duration(1500)*time.Millisecond, 2*time.Hour+30*time.Minute)
	fmt.Println(time.Duration(0), time.Duration(999), time.Duration(-1500)*time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println(math.Sqrt(16), math.Floor(-1.5), math.Ceil(-1.5), math.Abs(-3.25))
	fmt.Println(math.Pow(2, 10), math.Max(3, 7), math.Min(3, 7))
	fmt.Println(math.IsNaN(math.NaN()), math.IsInf(math.Inf(1), 1), math.MaxInt64, math.MinInt64)
	fmt.Printf("%.4f %.4f\n", math.Pi, math.E)
	start := time.Now()
	time.Sleep(2 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println("slept:", time.Since(start) >= 2*time.Millisecond)
}
